attributes.name: centerselected
attributes.description: Centers the carousel on the first element that has the `selected` attribute when the carousel first renders.

attributes.name: displayarrows
attributes.description: Shows the left and right scroll buttons at all times, instead of only when there's more content to scroll to in that direction. The buttons stay hidden on small screens.

attributes.name: scrolldistance
attributes.description: Sets how many pixels the carousel scrolls when someone selects the left or right button.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Deprecated: Use the `ariaLabel` slot instead. Sets the text that screen readers announce as the carousel's name.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The elements to scroll through, such as `auro-pane` elements or images.

slots.name: ariaLabel
slots.description: Text that screen readers announce as the carousel's name, for example "Flight date options". Takes priority over the `label` attribute.

slots.name: ariaLabel.scroll.left
slots.description: Text that screen readers announce for the left scroll button, for example "Show earlier dates". Defaults to "Scroll Left".

slots.name: ariaLabel.scroll.right
slots.description: Text that screen readers announce for the right scroll button, for example "Show later dates". Defaults to "Scroll Right".
